extracted.name: No-Mayo Mediterranean Tuna Salad
extracted.description: This Mediterranean tuna salad with red onion, parsley, and a light lemon dressing is packed with different flavors and textures for a refreshing lunch.
ingredient_lines: 2 (5 ounce) cans chunk light tuna in water, drained
instruction_lines: Combine tuna, onion, and parsley in a medium bowl.
